results.title: Robotics Apprenticeship | DVC
results.snippet: DVC’s robotics apprenticeship program prepares students for three industry-recognized, journey-level occupations in industrial automation and robotics. Registered apprentices can take DVC’s tuition-free courses to complete the instruction required for their chosen occupation.
